name: YOOPAI Dual Color Silk PLA @BBL A1 0.2 nozzle
filament_notes:
YOOPAI manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 55 C for 8 h.
Manufacturer max speed 80 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed lowered to 1.8 mm3/s (printer profile 7.5) from the manufacturer's 80 mm/s rating.
Temperature set for ~80 mm/s on this printer: 200 C (first layer 200 C). Manufacturer bands: 190-215 C at 50-150 mm/s; 215-230 C at 150-250 mm/s. Printing much faster or slower than this printer's default process? Adjust the nozzle temperature along those bands.
Two-tone coextrusion silk (Black Purple, Black Red, Blue Silver, Gold Silver, Pink Gold, Purple Gold, Red Blue, Red Gold; Purple Green appears in the 250g bundles). Not on yoopai.com. Amazon 1kg listing (B0GTTL5SSM) text: nozzle 190-215C, bed 30-60C, speed 50-80 mm/s (recorded). Its image gallery (also on the 4 x 250g dual-colour bundle B0GTTLMMFD and the Tri-Color listing) shows 190-215C @50-150 mm/s and 215-230C @150-250 mm/s (speed_temp_bands; conflicts with the 50-80 mm/s text). Drying 55C 8h is from the lineup comparison chart (generic 'PLA Silk' row) shown on the Amazon 'PLA Silk Dual Color 250g Starter Bundle' (B0H1N3SYYM); that chart's PLA Silk row also says 210-240C / <200 mm/s, which conflicts with the 1kg text. +/-0.03 mm.
Source: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GTTL5SSM
